notes:
ACCESS: reached entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in my own tab (no HTTP-layer routes). robots.txt read in-tab: generic 'User-agent: *' block plus a bingbot block; NO Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot directive, no full-site disallow. Magento storefront, all PLPs rendered by Searchspring (siteId nhbtv0).

ABSENCE PROOF (per section 6): (1) MEGA-MENU - dumped the whole .navigation tree from the DOM (412 anchors). The 12 top-level departments are NEW, LIGHTING, FANS, PENDANTS, LAMPS, GLOBES, Outdoor, ELECTRICAL, CLEARANCE, SHOP BY ROOM, INSPIRATION, SALE. There is no Furniture department and no furniture-typed child anywhere in it; 'SHOP BY ROOM' (/lighting-room/kitchen|dining|living-room|bedroom|bathroom|home-office) resolves only to lighting/fan children (kitchen-pendants, living-room-lamps, etc.). Footer carries a 13th entry 'Home Decor' -> /homewares.
(2) SITEMAP CROSS-CHECK (section 7b trap 1) - fetched /sitemap.xml same-origin from the loaded page: 7,158 URLs, of which 873 are category URLs. Filtered every category URL against the furniture slug list (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelving, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, ottoman, console, sideboard, drawer, vanity). Only 10 matched and all 10 are lighting: /lighting/strip-cabinet-lights, /lighting/lamps/table-lamps, /lighting/lamps/desk-lamps, /lighting/lamps/bedside-lamps, /lighting/downlights/adjustable-downlights, /lighting/downlights/adaptable, /lighting/strip-cabinet-lights/masson-strip-lighting and the three /lighting-lamps/* duplicates. The whole /homewares branch has exactly four children: Candles & Accessories, Cleaning, Decorative, Homewares Brands - no furniture node. /outdoor/* is outdoor lighting and outdoor fans only (no outdoor/garden furniture).
(3) PRODUCT-LEVEL TITLE SCAN (section 7c) - scanned all 6,285 product URLs in the sitemap for furniture terms and stripped lighting/fan/electrical noise. TOTAL 6285 / clear non-furniture 6277 / candidates 8 / verified 4. The 8 candidates were: 4x Tatum tables, 'white-moose-shelf-monkey-in-white' and 'white-moose-table-snail-in-gold' (decorative resin figurines, White Moose homewares brand), 'skywire-stand-off-suspension-in-black' (lighting suspension hardware) and 'the-block-bedroom' (a landing page). The only genuine furniture SKUs on the entire site are FOUR: Tatum 450mm Side Table in Black / in Chalk White, and Tatum 600mm Coffee Table in Black / in Chalk White. Opened https://www.beaconlighting.com.au/tatum-450mm-side-table-in-black (HTTP 200, h1 'Tatum 450mm Side Table in Black', SKU 131113) - it has no breadcrumb and its Searchspring top_web_category facet reads 'Accessories -> 4'. They are merchandised inside the Homewares department (Homewares parent listing rendered header '51 products' and its grid links to the Tatum items), alongside candles, diffusers, cleaning products and decorative objects. There is no furniture-primary listing node for them, so per section 3 (never extract individual product-detail pages) and section 2 (no valid furniture leaf exists) no row is emitted. Flagging this here so a reviewer can see the 4 SKUs exist.
(4) SEARCH DISCRIMINATION CHECK (section 6.3) - queried the site's own Searchspring search.json endpoint (the same layer the storefront JS uses) from the loaded page. Nonsense control 'xyzzy' -> 0; positive control 'pendant' -> 756, so search discriminates and a 0 is meaningful. Results: wardrobe 0, bookcase 0, armchair 0, bench 0, sideboard 0, bed frame 0, furniture 0. The non-zero furniture-word queries are Searchspring fuzzy matches on lighting, verified by pulling the returned product slugs: 'sofa' -> 73 returns ceiling fans and bathroom heaters; 'stool' -> 242 returns pendants, sconces and lamp shades; 'cabinet' -> 44 returns under-cabinet strip lights; 'desk' -> 63 returns desk lamps; 'dining table' -> 22 returns dining pendants. 'side table' -> 2 and 'coffee table' -> 2 are exactly the Tatum pair, consistent with the sitemap scan.

CONCLUSION: Beacon Lighting is a pure lighting/ceiling-fan/electrical specialist with a small homewares (candles + decor) side range. It has no furniture category, no furniture department and no furniture listing page anywhere in nav, sitemap or category tree - only 4 stray occasional-table SKUs filed under Homewares/Accessories. Result: status ok, rows []. No blocks or rate limits were encountered; the two [BLOCKED: Cookie/query string data] responses were the MCP connector's own output-redaction filter (section 7c), resolved by stripping query strings from the returned data.
